ko.title: 이거 어떻게 버려요?
ko.subtitle: 사진을 찍거나 이름을 적으면, 한국에서 어떻게 버리는지 알려줘요.
ko.shootHint: 여러 개를 함께 찍어도 각각 알려줘요. 사진은 판단에만 쓰고 저장하지 않아요.
ko.disclaimer: 공공데이터 기준으로 정리했어요. 아파트·상가는 자체 규칙이 있을 수 있으니 관리사무소나 동 행정복지센터 안내를 우선하세요. 규정을 어기면 과태료가 나올 수 있어요.
ko.err: 판단하지 못했어요. 더 선명한 사진으로 다시 해보세요.
ko.busy: 지금 사용하는 사람이 많아요. 잠시 뒤에 다시 해보세요.
ko.tooBig: 사진이 너무 커요. 다른 사진을 써주세요.
ko.helpSub: 번호를 누르면 바로 전화가 걸려요. 말이 안 통하면 아래 한국어 문장을 틀어주세요.
ko.buildHint: 상황을 고르고 위치를 적으면, 전화로 들려줄 한국어 문장을 만들어 줘요.
ko.noVoice: 이 기기는 음성 읽기를 지원하지 않아요. 화면을 상대에게 보여주세요.
ko.checkedNote: 번호와 운영 시간은 공식 자료로 확인했어요(2026년 10월 기준). 바뀔 수 있어요.
ko.noItem: 버릴 물건을 못 찾았어요. 버리고 싶은 물건 이름을 적어주세요 (예: 피자 박스). 요일·시간은 '내 지역'에 있어요.
ko.areaOtherText: 대부분 지역은 해가 진 뒤부터 자정 사이, 집 앞이나 정해진 장소에 내놓습니다. 요일은 동네마다 달라서 건물 관리실이나 이웃에게 물어보는 게 가장 정확해요. 1330(관광통역)에 전화하면 외국어로 물어볼 수 있어요.
ko.checkedL: {d}에 공식 홈페이지에서 확인했어요. 규칙은 바뀔 수 있으니 건물 관리실 안내가 우선이에요.
ko.bagHint: 종류와 크기를 고르고, 계산대에서 이 화면을 보여주거나 '소리로 듣기'를 누르세요.
ko.bagNote: 봉투는 편의점·마트에서 팔아요. 사는 시·군·구에서 사야 하고, 크기와 가격은 지역마다 달라요. 없는 크기면 다른 크기를 고르세요.
ko.noMatch: 목록에 없어요. '사진' 탭에서 이름을 적어 물어보세요.

en.title: How do I throw this away?
en.subtitle: Take a photo or type what it is — we'll tell you how to throw it away in Korea.
en.shootTitle: Take a photo of the item
en.shootHint: You can photograph several items at once. Your photo is only used to check them and is never saved.
en.thinking: Checking, this takes a few seconds…
en.quickHint: No photo needed. Tap one to see.
en.showKo: Show this to a Korean neighbor or building manager
en.disclaimer: Based on public data. Apartments and shops may have their own rules, so follow your building office or local community center first. Breaking the rules can lead to a fine.
en.err: We couldn't tell. Try again with a clearer photo.
en.busy: Lots of people are using this right now. Please try again in a moment.
en.tooBig: The photo is too large. Please use another one.
en.unsure: Hard to see. Please take another photo
en.helpSub: Tap a number to call right away. If they can't understand you, play the Korean sentence below.
en.buildHint: Pick what happened and where you are. We'll make a Korean sentence you can play on the phone.
en.placeLabel: Where are you? (sign, building or station name)
en.placePh: e.g. Seoul Station exit 2 (as on Korean signs)
en.noVoice: This device can't read aloud. Show the screen to the other person.
en.checkedNote: Numbers and hours checked against official sources (October 2026). They may change.
en.noItem: No item to throw away found. Type the name of the thing (e.g. pizza box). For days and times, see 'My area'.
en.areaTitle: Trash days & times in my area
en.areaOtherText: In most areas, trash goes out after sunset and before midnight, in front of your building or at a set spot. Days differ by neighborhood, so your building office or neighbors know best. You can also call 1330 to ask in your language.
en.checkedL: Checked on the official website on {d}. Rules can change — your building office comes first.
en.bagTitle: Buy trash bags at a convenience store
en.bagHint: Pick the type and size, then show this screen at the counter or press Read aloud.
en.bagNote: Bags are sold at convenience stores and marts. Buy them in the city/district where you live; sizes and prices differ by area. If a size isn't sold, pick another.
en.mCheck: Is this bag for this neighborhood?
en.noMatch: Not in the list. Type it on the Photo tab to ask.

zh.tagline: 利川市 · 垃圾分类翻译
zh.title: 这个垃圾怎么扔？
zh.subtitle: 拍张照或写下是什么，告诉你在韩国怎么扔。
zh.shootHint: 可以一次拍好几样东西。照片只用来判断，不会保存。
zh.thinking: 正在识别，大约需要几秒…
zh.quickHint: 不用拍照，点一下就能看。
zh.rulesTitle: 基本规定（韩国大部分地区）
zh.showKo: 给韩国邻居或管理员看
zh.disclaimer: 规定依据公共数据整理。公寓、商铺可能有自己的规则，请以管理处或洞行政福利中心的说明为准。违反规定可能被罚款。
zh.err: 识别失败，请换一张更清楚的照片再试。
zh.busy: 现在使用的人太多，请稍后再试。
zh.helpSub: 点号码就能直接打电话。如果对方听不懂，请播放下面的韩语句子。
zh.buildHint: 选择发生了什么、写下你在哪里，就会生成可以在电话里播放的韩语句子。
zh.placeLabel: 你在哪里？（招牌、建筑或车站名）
zh.placePh: 例：首尔站2号出口（按韩文招牌写）
zh.noVoice: 这台设备不支持朗读。请把屏幕给对方看。
zh.checkedNote: 号码和时间已按官方资料核对（2026年10月）。可能会有变化。
zh.noItem: 没找到要扔的东西。请写下物品名称（例如：披萨盒）。扔垃圾的日期和时间请看“我的地区”。
zh.areaTitle: 我所在地区的扔垃圾日期和时间
zh.areaHint: 请选择你所在的市、郡或区。
zh.areaOtherText: 大多数地区在日落后到午夜之间，把垃圾放在楼前或指定地点。哪天扔各小区不同，问物业或邻居最准确。也可以拨打1330用中文咨询。
zh.checkedL: 已于{d}在官方网站核对。规定可能变化，以物业的通知为准。
zh.bagHint: 选好种类和大小，在收银台给店员看这个画面，或点“朗读”。
zh.bagNote: 垃圾袋在便利店、超市有卖。要买你所住市、郡、区的袋子，大小和价格各地不同。没有这个尺寸就换一个。
zh.mGen: 请给我{N}个{L}升的一般垃圾袋。
zh.mFood: 请给我{N}个{L}升的厨余垃圾袋。
zh.mSack: 请给我{N}个不可燃垃圾麻袋。
zh.mCheck: 这是这个地区的袋子吗？
zh.noMatch: 列表里没有。请在“拍照”页输入名称来问。

v.zh: 各小区不同，请看“我的地区”

v.ko: 집 앞이나 동네에서 정한 장소 (건물마다 달라요)
v.en: In front of your building or your neighborhood's set spot (ask your building)
v.zh: 楼前或小区指定地点（各楼不同，请问物业）

v.ko: 보통 해 진 뒤부터 자정까지. 지역마다 달라요
v.en: Usually after sunset until midnight. Differs by area
v.zh: 一般在日落后到午夜之间，各地不同

v.en: Use the official pay-as-you-throw bag (sold at convenience stores and marts)
v.zh: 装进计量垃圾袋（便利店、超市有卖）

v.ko: 사는 시·군·구에서 산 봉투만 쓰세요. 다른 지역 봉투는 안 가져갈 수 있어요
v.en: Use bags bought in the city/district where you live. Bags from other areas may not be picked up
v.zh: 只用你所住市、郡、区买的袋子，其他地区的袋子可能不会被收走

v.en: Drain the water, food only, in the food-waste bag
v.zh: 沥干水分，只放食物，用专用袋

v.en: Put in a clear plastic bag or tie it up
v.zh: 装进透明塑料袋或捆好

v.ko: 길에는 쓰레기통이 적어요. 숙소에 가져가 버리거나 지하철역 등의 공공 쓰레기통을 이용하세요
v.en: Street trash cans are rare in Korea. Take trash back to your hotel or use public bins, for example at subway stations
v.zh: 韩国街上垃圾桶很少。请带回住处扔，或使用地铁站等处的公共垃圾桶

ko.name: 페트병
steps: 라벨 떼고 찌그러뜨린 뒤 뚜껑 닫기
투명 페트병은 다른 플라스틱과 따로, 투명 페트병 전용 칸이나 봉투에 배출

en.name: Plastic drink bottle
steps: Remove the label, crush it, put the cap back on
Put clear bottles out separately from other plastics, in the clear-PET bin or bag

zh.name: 塑料饮料瓶
steps: 撕掉标签，压扁，盖上盖子
透明塑料瓶要和其他塑料分开，放进透明塑料瓶专用桶或袋

ko.name: 치킨·돼지 뼈
ko.warn: 뼈를 음식물로 버리면 처리 기계가 고장 나요.

en.name: Chicken or pork bones
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Bones in food waste break the processing machines.

zh.name: 鸡骨头、猪骨头
zh.warn: 骨头放进厨余垃圾会弄坏处理机器。

ko.name: 계란 껍데기
ko.warn: 계란 껍데기는 음식물이 아니에요.

en.name: Eggshells
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Eggshells are not food waste.

zh.name: 鸡蛋壳
zh.warn: 蛋壳不能当厨余垃圾。

ko.name: 바나나·사과 껍질
ko.warn: 딱딱한 껍질·씨(호두, 복숭아씨, 두리안)는 종량제 봉투로.

en.name: Banana or apple peel
steps: Put it in the food-waste bag
en.warn: Hard shells and pits (walnut, peach pit, durian) go in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 香蕉皮、苹果皮
zh.warn: 硬的壳和核（核桃壳、桃核、榴莲壳）要放计量垃圾袋。

en.name: Clam or crab shells
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag

en.name: Milk carton
steps: Rinse, dry and open it flat
Keep it separate from regular paper

ko.name: 깨끗한 비닐봉지
ko.warn: 음식·기름 묻은 비닐은 종량제 봉투로.

en.name: Clean plastic bag
steps: Collect them and put out with plastic film recycling
en.warn: Plastic bags with food or oil on them go in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 干净的塑料袋
steps: 几个装在一起，放到塑料袋回收
zh.warn: 沾了油或食物的塑料袋放计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 소주병·맥주병
steps: 마트에서 빈 병 보증금 환불 가능

en.name: Soju or beer bottle
steps: Empty it and keep it unbroken
You can return it at a mart for a bottle deposit refund

zh.name: 烧酒瓶、啤酒瓶
steps: 可以拿到超市退瓶押金

ko.name: 깨진 유리·도자기
ko.warn: 종량제 봉투에 넣으면 미화원이 다칠 수 있어요.

en.name: Broken glass or ceramics
steps: Wrap it in newspaper so no one gets cut
Put it in the special sack for non-burnable waste
en.warn: In a regular trash bag it can injure sanitation workers.

zh.name: 碎玻璃、陶瓷碗
steps: 放进专用麻袋（不可燃垃圾）
zh.warn: 不要放进计量垃圾袋，会伤到清洁工。

en.name: Batteries
steps: Drop them in a used-battery box at a community center or apartment complex

zh.name: 电池
steps: 放进社区中心或公寓的废电池回收箱

ko.name: 깨끗한 스티로폼
ko.warn: 색깔 있거나 음식 묻은 건 종량제 봉투로.

en.name: Clean styrofoam
en.warn: Colored or food-stained styrofoam goes in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 干净的泡沫箱
zh.warn: 有颜色或沾了食物的泡沫放计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 영수증
ko.warn: 영수증은 감열지라 종이로 재활용이 안 돼요.

en.name: Receipt
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Receipts are thermal paper and can't be recycled as paper.

zh.name: 收据
zh.warn: 收据是热敏纸，不能当纸回收。

en.name: Used tissue
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag

ko.name: 소파·매트리스·가구
ko.warn: 신고 없이 내놓으면 과태료 대상이에요.

en.name: Sofa, mattress, furniture
steps: Report it as bulky waste at your community center or online
Pay the fee and attach the sticker
Put it out on the agreed day
en.warn: Putting it out without reporting can lead to a fine.

zh.name: 沙发、床垫、柜子
steps: 先到洞行政福利中心或网上申报大型垃圾
zh.warn: 没有申报直接扔会被罚款。

ko.name: 배달 플라스틱 용기
ko.warn: 음식 얼룩이 안 지워지면 재활용이 안 돼요. 그때는 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Plastic delivery food container
steps: Rinse with water and remove labels and plastic film
Put it in the plastics bin
en.warn: If food stains won't come off, it can't be recycled. Then put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 外卖塑料餐盒
steps: 用水冲洗，撕掉标签和塑料膜
zh.warn: 食物污渍洗不掉就不能回收，这时放进计量垃圾袋。

en.name: Instant rice container
steps: Peel off the plastic lid film
Empty out the rice and rinse
Put it in the plastics bin

ko.name: 요거트 용기
ko.warn: 떼어낸 뚜껑(은박·필름)은 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Yogurt cup
steps: Put it in the plastics bin
en.warn: Put the peeled-off lid (foil or film) in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 酸奶杯
zh.warn: 撕下来的盖子（铝箔、薄膜）放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 종이 컵라면 용기
ko.warn: 음식이 묻어 있으면 재활용이 안 돼요.

en.name: Paper cup noodle container
steps: Empty out the soup and noodles
en.warn: If there is food on it, it can't be recycled.

zh.name: 纸碗杯面
zh.warn: 沾着食物就不能回收。

ko.name: 스티로폼 컵라면·포장 용기
ko.warn: 음식물이 묻어 안 지워지면 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Styrofoam cup noodle or food container
steps: Empty out the food and rinse
Put it in the styrofoam bin
en.warn: If food stains won't come off, put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 泡沫杯面碗、泡沫餐盒
zh.warn: 沾了食物洗不掉的话，放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 카페 플라스틱 컵
ko.warn: 투명 페트병 전용함에 넣으면 안 돼요. 일부 지역의 보증금 대상 컵이면 매장에 반납하면 돈을 돌려받아요.

en.name: Plastic cafe cup
steps: Empty out the drink and rinse
Put it in the plastics bin
en.warn: Don't put it in the clear PET bottle bin. If it is a deposit cup (in some areas), return it to the store to get money back.

zh.name: 咖啡店塑料杯
zh.warn: 不要放进透明塑料瓶（PET）专用回收箱。如果是部分地区的押金杯，退回店里可以拿回押金。

ko.name: 종이컵
ko.warn: 지역마다 달라요. 서울시는 양면 코팅 종이컵을 종량제봉투로 버리라고 안내해요.

en.name: Paper cup
steps: Tie them together and put out with paper
en.warn: Rules differ by area. Seoul says to put paper cups coated on both sides in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 纸杯
steps: 捆在一起放到纸类回收
zh.warn: 各地规定不同。首尔规定双面淋膜纸杯放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 빨대
steps: 플라스틱 빨대는 플라스틱으로, 금속 빨대는 고철로 내놓아요
ko.warn: 우유팩에 붙은 빨대는 떼서 따로 버려요.

en.name: Straw
steps: Plastic straws go out with plastics, metal straws with scrap metal
en.warn: Remove straws attached to milk cartons and throw them out separately.

zh.name: 吸管
steps: 塑料吸管放塑料回收，金属吸管放废铁回收
zh.warn: 牛奶盒上的吸管要拿下来，单独扔。

ko.name: 과자·라면 봉지
ko.warn: 기름이나 양념이 안 씻기면 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Snack or ramyeon wrapper
steps: Put it in the plastic film (비닐) bin
en.warn: If oil or seasoning won't wash off, put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 零食袋、方便面袋
zh.warn: 油或调料洗不掉的话，放进计量垃圾袋。

en.name: Plastic gloves or zipper bag
steps: Empty it and remove any dirt or food
Put it in the plastic film (비닐) bin

ko.name: 랩
ko.warn: 배달 음식·마트 포장 랩은 PVC라 재활용이 안 돼요.

en.name: Plastic wrap
steps: Clean wrap goes out with plastic film
Wrap with food on it goes in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Wrap from delivery food and supermarket packs is PVC and can't be recycled.

zh.name: 保鲜膜
steps: 干净的保鲜膜放到塑料袋类回收
沾了食物的保鲜膜放进计量垃圾袋
zh.warn: 外卖和超市包装用的保鲜膜是PVC，不能回收。

en.name: Bubble wrap
steps: Put it in the plastic film (비닐) bin

ko.name: 물 아이스팩
ko.warn: 젤 아이스팩은 방법이 달라요.

en.name: Water ice pack
steps: Cut the pack and pour the water down the drain
Put the plastic pouch out with plastic film
en.warn: Gel ice packs are handled differently.

zh.name: 水冰袋
steps: 剪开冰袋，把水倒进下水道
塑料袋放到塑料袋类回收
zh.warn: 凝胶冰袋的扔法不一样。

ko.name: 젤 아이스팩
steps: 아이스팩 수거함이 있으면 거기에, 없으면 종량제봉투에 넣어요
ko.warn: 물 아이스팩과 달리 뜯지 않고 그대로 버려요.

en.name: Gel ice pack
steps: Don't open it; throw it out whole
Put it in an ice pack collection box if there is one; if not, in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Unlike water ice packs, throw it out as is without opening it.

zh.name: 凝胶冰袋
steps: 有冰袋回收箱就放进去，没有就放进计量垃圾袋
zh.warn: 和水冰袋不同，不剪开，直接扔。

ko.name: 칫솔
ko.warn: 플라스틱처럼 보여도 재활용이 안 돼요.

en.name: Toothbrush
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: It looks like plastic but can't be recycled.

zh.name: 牙刷
zh.warn: 看起来像塑料，但不能回收。

ko.name: 우산
ko.warn: 지역마다 달라요. 서울시는 큰 우산을 대형폐기물로 안내해요.

en.name: Umbrella
steps: Remove the plastic or fabric and put the frame out with scrap metal
If it's hard to take apart, put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Rules differ by area. Seoul treats large umbrellas as bulky waste (대형폐기물).

zh.name: 雨伞
steps: 拆下塑料或布，伞骨放到废铁回收
不好拆的话，放进计量垃圾袋
zh.warn: 各地规定不同。首尔把大雨伞算作大型垃圾（대형폐기물）。

ko.name: 헌 옷
ko.warn: 찢어지거나 더러운 옷은 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Old clothes
steps: Make sure they are clean and dry
Put them in the clothing bin (의류수거함)
en.warn: Torn or dirty clothes go in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 旧衣服
zh.warn: 破了或脏的衣服放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 신발(운동화·구두)
ko.warn: 슬리퍼·고무신발, 낡은 신발은 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Shoes (sneakers, dress shoes)
steps: Tie the pair together with a string
If in good condition, put them in the clothing bin (의류수거함)
en.warn: Slippers, rubber shoes and worn-out shoes go in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 鞋（运动鞋、皮鞋）
steps: 用绳子把两只绑在一起
状态好的放进旧衣回收箱（의류수거함）
zh.warn: 拖鞋、橡胶鞋和旧鞋放进计量垃圾袋。

en.name: Bag
steps: If in good condition, put it in the clothing bin (의류수거함)
If worn out, use the pay-as-you-throw bag; if large, put it out as bulky waste (대형폐기물)

zh.name: 包
steps: 状态好的放进旧衣回收箱（의류수거함）
旧的放计量垃圾袋，大的按大型垃圾（대형폐기물）扔

ko.name: 여행용 캐리어
ko.warn: 의류 수거함에 넣으면 안 돼요.

en.name: Suitcase
steps: Attach the sticker and put it out
en.warn: Don't put it in the clothing bin.

zh.name: 旅行箱
zh.warn: 不要放进旧衣回收箱。

ko.name: 솜이불
ko.warn: 의류 수거함에 넣으면 안 돼요. 작은 이불은 종량제봉투에 넣게 하는 지역도 있어요.

en.name: Cotton quilt
steps: Attach the sticker and put it out
en.warn: Don't put it in the clothing bin. Some areas let you put small quilts in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 棉被
zh.warn: 不要放进旧衣回收箱。有些地区小被子可以放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 베개·쿠션
ko.warn: 의류 수거함에 넣으면 안 돼요.

en.name: Pillow or cushion
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
If it doesn't fit in the bag, put it out as bulky waste (대형폐기물)
en.warn: Don't put it in the clothing bin.

zh.name: 枕头、靠垫
steps: 装不进袋子的话，按大型垃圾（대형폐기물）扔
zh.warn: 不要放进旧衣回收箱。

ko.name: 인형
ko.warn: 의류 수거함에 넣으면 안 돼요.

en.name: Stuffed toy
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
If it's too big, put it out as bulky waste (대형폐기물)
en.warn: Don't put it in the clothing bin.

zh.name: 毛绒玩具
steps: 太大的话，按大型垃圾（대형폐기물）扔
zh.warn: 不要放进旧衣回收箱。

ko.name: 장난감
steps: 건전지가 들어간 장난감은 소형 전자제품 수거함에 넣어요
ko.warn: 유모차·보행기 같은 큰 것은 대형폐기물이에요.

en.name: Toys
steps: If made of mixed materials, put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
Toys with batteries go in the small electronics bin
en.warn: Big items like strollers and baby walkers are bulky waste (대형폐기물).

zh.name: 玩具
steps: 多种材料混在一起的，放进计量垃圾袋
装电池的玩具放进小家电回收箱
zh.warn: 婴儿车、学步车等大件属于大型垃圾（대형폐기물）。

en.name: Fluorescent lamp
steps: Keep it whole so it doesn't break
Put it in a fluorescent lamp bin (community center or apartment complex)

zh.name: 荧光灯
steps: 放进荧光灯回收箱（社区中心、公寓）

ko.name: 깨진 형광등
ko.warn: 지역마다 달라요. 서울시는 소량이면 감싸서 종량제봉투에 넣어도 된다고 안내해요.

en.name: Broken fluorescent lamp
steps: Wrap it several times in newspaper
Put it in the special sack for non-burnable waste (불연성 마대)
en.warn: Rules differ by area. Seoul says small amounts can be wrapped and put in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 碎荧光灯
steps: 放进不可燃垃圾专用麻袋（불연성 마대）
zh.warn: 各地规定不同。首尔规定少量的包好后可以放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: LED 전구
steps: 납작한 LED 조명은 불연성 마대나 대형폐기물로 내놓아요

en.name: LED bulb
steps: Bulb-type and tube-type LEDs go in the fluorescent lamp bin
Flat LED lights go in the non-burnable waste sack (불연성 마대) or out as bulky waste (대형폐기물)

zh.name: LED灯
steps: 灯泡型、灯管型LED放进荧光灯回收箱
扁平的LED灯放进不可燃垃圾麻袋（불연성 마대），或按大型垃圾（대형폐기물）扔

ko.name: 보조배터리
steps: 소형 전자제품 수거함이나 전지 수거함에 넣어요
ko.warn: 불이 날 수 있으니 플라스틱·캔 같은 재활용품에 섞으면 안 돼요.

en.name: Power bank
steps: Put it in a small electronics bin or a battery box (폐건전지 수거함)
en.warn: It can catch fire, so never mix it with recyclables like plastics or cans.

zh.name: 充电宝
steps: 放进小家电回收箱或电池回收箱（폐건전지 수거함）
zh.warn: 可能起火，不要混进塑料、易拉罐等回收物里。

ko.name: 휴대폰
ko.warn: 5개 이상 모으면 무료 방문수거(1599-0903)를 쓸 수 있어요.

en.name: Mobile phone
steps: Put it in the small electronics bin
en.warn: If you collect 5 or more, you can use free home pickup (1599-0903).

zh.name: 手机
zh.warn: 攒够5台以上可以用免费上门回收（1599-0903）。

en.name: Charger or earphones
steps: Put them in the small electronics bin

en.name: Small appliances (hair dryer, hair iron, etc.)
steps: Put them in the small electronics bin
If there's no bin, ask your community center

zh.name: 吹风机、卷发棒等小家电
steps: 没有回收箱的话，问社区中心

en.name: E-cigarette
steps: Put it in the small electronics bin

ko.name: 프라이팬·냄비
ko.warn: 다른 재질이 많이 붙어 있으면 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Frying pan or pot
steps: Put it in the scrap metal bin
en.warn: If a lot of other material is attached, put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 平底锅、锅
zh.warn: 粘着很多其他材料的话，放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 큰 거울
ko.warn: 유리병 수거함에 넣으면 안 돼요.

en.name: Large mirror
steps: Attach the sticker and put it out
en.warn: Don't put it in the glass bottle bin.

zh.name: 大镜子
zh.warn: 不要放进玻璃瓶回收箱。

ko.name: 유리컵·와인잔
ko.warn: 유리병 수거함에 넣으면 안 돼요. 1~2개는 잘 싸서 종량제봉투에 넣어도 돼요.

en.name: Drinking glass or wine glass
steps: Wrap it so it doesn't break
Put it in the special sack for non-burnable waste (불연성 마대)
en.warn: Don't put it in the glass bottle bin. One or two can go in the pay-as-you-throw bag if wrapped well.

zh.name: 玻璃杯、红酒杯
steps: 放进不可燃垃圾专用麻袋（불연성 마대）
zh.warn: 不要放进玻璃瓶回收箱。一两个包好后可以放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 스프레이 캔
steps: 바람이 잘 통하는 곳에서 노즐을 눌러 가스를 다 빼요
ko.warn: 가스가 남아 있으면 불이 날 수 있어요.

en.name: Spray can
steps: In a well-ventilated place, press the nozzle to let all the gas out
Put it in the can bin
en.warn: Leftover gas can cause a fire.

zh.name: 喷雾罐
steps: 在通风好的地方按住喷嘴，把气放完
zh.warn: 罐里有剩余气体可能会起火。

ko.name: 부탄가스
steps: 바람이 잘 통하는 곳에서 노즐을 눌러 가스를 다 빼요
ko.warn: 구멍을 뚫으라고 안내하는 지역도 있어요. 사는 곳 안내를 확인해요.

en.name: Butane gas can
steps: In a well-ventilated place, press the nozzle to let all the gas out
Put it in the can bin
en.warn: Some areas tell you to punch a hole in it. Check your local rules.

zh.name: 丁烷气罐
steps: 在通风好的地方按住喷嘴，把气放完
zh.warn: 有些地区要求扎孔。请确认你所在地区的规定。

ko.name: 남은 페인트
ko.warn: 수거함이 없으면 밀봉해서 지자체 안내대로(보통 종량제봉투) 버려요.

en.name: Leftover paint
steps: Close the lid tightly to seal it
Put it in the hazardous waste bin
en.warn: If there's no bin, seal it and throw it out as your local government says (usually in the pay-as-you-throw bag).

zh.name: 剩余油漆
zh.warn: 没有回收箱的话，密封后按地方政府的规定扔（通常放计量垃圾袋）。

ko.name: 먹다 남은 알약
ko.warn: 일부 지역은 우체통에도 넣을 수 있어요.

en.name: Leftover pills
steps: Remove the outer box and throw it out separately
Put only the pills together in a bag
Put them in the used-medicine box at a pharmacy, public health center or community center
en.warn: In some areas you can also put them in a mailbox.

zh.name: 吃剩的药片
steps: 只把药片集中装进袋子
放进药店、保健所或社区中心的废药品回收箱
zh.warn: 部分地区也可以投进邮筒。

ko.name: 물약·연고
ko.warn: 물약은 우체통에 넣으면 안 돼요.

en.name: Liquid medicine or ointment
steps: Close the lid, keeping it in its container
Put it in the used-medicine box at a pharmacy, public health center or community center
en.warn: Don't put liquid medicine in a mailbox.

zh.name: 药水、药膏
steps: 放进药店、保健所或社区中心的废药品回收箱
zh.warn: 药水不能投进邮筒。

ko.name: 티백·녹차 잎
ko.warn: 음식물 쓰레기가 아니에요.

en.name: Tea bags or green tea leaves
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: They are not food waste.

zh.name: 茶包、绿茶叶
zh.warn: 不是厨余垃圾。

ko.name: 견과류 껍데기
ko.warn: 호두·땅콩·밤 껍데기는 음식물 쓰레기가 아니에요.

en.name: Nut shells
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Walnut, peanut and chestnut shells are not food waste.

zh.name: 坚果壳
zh.warn: 核桃、花生、栗子的壳不是厨余垃圾。

ko.name: 딱딱한 과일 씨
ko.warn: 음식물 쓰레기가 아니에요.

en.name: Hard fruit pits
steps: Put peach, avocado and persimmon pits in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: They are not food waste.

zh.name: 硬的果核
steps: 桃核、牛油果核、柿子核放进计量垃圾袋
zh.warn: 不是厨余垃圾。

ko.name: 양파·마늘 껍질
ko.warn: 음식물 쓰레기가 아니에요.

en.name: Onion or garlic skins
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: They are not food waste.

zh.name: 洋葱皮、大蒜皮
zh.warn: 不是厨余垃圾。

ko.name: 옥수수 껍질·대
ko.warn: 음식물 쓰레기가 아니에요.

en.name: Corn husks or cobs
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: They are not food waste.

zh.name: 玉米皮、玉米芯
zh.warn: 不是厨余垃圾。

ko.name: 생선 뼈·가시
ko.warn: 아주 적은 양은 음식물 쓰레기로 받는 곳도 있어요.

en.name: Fish bones
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Some places accept very small amounts as food waste.

zh.name: 鱼骨、鱼刺
zh.warn: 有些地方很少量的可以当厨余垃圾收。

en.name: Kimchi or soupy food
steps: Strain off the liquid and squeeze out the water
Put it out as food waste

en.name: Expired food
steps: Put it out as food waste

en.name: Used cooking oil
steps: Collect it without mixing in food
Put it in the used cooking oil bin

zh.name: 废食用油
steps: 收集起来，不要混进食物

en.name: Rubber gloves
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag

en.name: Diapers
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag

en.name: Sanitary pads
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag

ko.name: 물티슈
steps: 포장 비닐은 비닐류, 플라스틱 캡은 플라스틱으로 내놓아요

en.name: Wet wipes
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
The plastic pack goes out with plastic film, the plastic cap with plastics

zh.name: 湿巾
steps: 包装袋放到塑料袋类回收，塑料盖放到塑料回收

en.name: Disposable mask
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag

ko.name: 로션·샴푸 용기
ko.warn: 펌프는 재활용이 안 돼요. 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Lotion or shampoo bottle
steps: Remove the pump and plastic label
Put the bottle in the plastics bin
en.warn: The pump can't be recycled. Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 乳液瓶、洗发水瓶
steps: 拆下按压泵和塑料标签
zh.warn: 按压泵不能回收，放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 향수병
steps: 남은 향수는 휴지에 흡수시켜 종량제봉투에 넣어요

en.name: Perfume bottle
steps: Soak up leftover perfume with tissue and put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
Put the bottle in the glass bottle bin

zh.name: 香水瓶
steps: 剩下的香水用纸巾吸干，放进计量垃圾袋
瓶子放进玻璃瓶回收箱

ko.name: 택배 송장
ko.warn: 종이처럼 보여도 재활용이 안 돼요.

en.name: Shipping label
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: It looks like paper but can't be recycled.

zh.name: 快递单
zh.warn: 看起来像纸，但不能回收。

ko.name: 박스 테이프
ko.warn: 안 떨어지면 칼로 테이프 부분을 잘라내요.

en.name: Packing tape
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: If it won't come off, cut out the taped part with a knife.

zh.name: 封箱胶带
zh.warn: 撕不下来的话，用刀把带胶带的部分割掉。

ko.name: 전단지
steps: 코팅 안 된 전단지는 종이류로 내놓아요

en.name: Flyers
steps: Uncoated flyers go out with paper
Coated, shiny flyers go in the pay-as-you-throw bag

zh.name: 传单
steps: 没有覆膜的传单放到纸类回收
覆膜发亮的传单放进计量垃圾袋

en.name: Books or notebooks
steps: Remove spiral bindings and plastic covers
Tie them together and put out with paper

zh.name: 书、笔记本
steps: 捆在一起放到纸类回收

en.name: Newspapers
steps: Flatten and stack them, keeping them dry
Tie them with string and put out with paper

zh.name: 报纸
steps: 用绳子捆好，放到纸类回收

en.name: Egg carton
steps: Paper egg cartons go out with paper
Plastic egg cartons go out with plastics

zh.name: 鸡蛋托
steps: 纸鸡蛋托放到纸类回收
塑料鸡蛋托放到塑料回收

en.name: Pizza or chicken box
steps: Clean boxes go out with paper
Put oily parts in the pay-as-you-throw bag

zh.name: 披萨盒、炸鸡盒
steps: 干净的盒子放到纸类回收
沾油的部分放进计量垃圾袋

ko.name: 종이 쇼핑백
ko.warn: 비닐 코팅 쇼핑백은 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Paper shopping bag
en.warn: Plastic-coated shopping bags go in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 纸购物袋
zh.warn: 有塑料覆膜的购物袋放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 종이 보냉 박스
ko.warn: 은박이 안 떨어지면 종량제봉투에 넣어요.

en.name: Paper insulated box
steps: Peel off the foil lining inside
en.warn: If the foil won't come off, put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag.

zh.name: 纸质保温箱
zh.warn: 铝箔撕不下来的话，放进计量垃圾袋。

ko.name: 알루미늄 호일
ko.warn: 캔이나 고철로 내놓으면 안 돼요.

en.name: Aluminum foil
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Don't put it out with cans or scrap metal.

zh.name: 铝箔纸
zh.warn: 不要放到罐类或废铁回收。

ko.name: 종이 호일
ko.warn: 종이류가 아니에요.

en.name: Baking paper
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: It is not paper recycling.

zh.name: 烘焙纸
zh.warn: 不属于纸类回收。

ko.name: 나무젓가락
ko.warn: 음식물 쓰레기에 넣으면 안 돼요.

en.name: Wooden chopsticks
steps: Put them in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Don't put them in food waste.

zh.name: 一次性木筷
zh.warn: 不要放进厨余垃圾。

en.name: Ballpoint pen
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag

ko.name: 일회용 라이터
steps: 햇빛에 닿지 않게 종이에 싸서 종량제봉투에 넣어요

en.name: Disposable lighter
steps: Use up all the gas first
Wrap it in paper away from sunlight and put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag

zh.name: 一次性打火机
steps: 用纸包好避免阳光照射，放进计量垃圾袋

en.name: Disposable razor
steps: Wrap the blade in paper or tape
Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag

ko.name: 일회용 손난로(핫팩)
ko.warn: 철가루가 들어 있어도 고철이 아니에요.

en.name: Disposable hand warmer (hot pack)
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: It has iron powder inside, but it is not scrap metal.

zh.name: 一次性暖宝宝
zh.warn: 里面有铁粉，但不算废铁。

ko.name: 담뱃갑
ko.warn: 비닐·은박을 떼면 비닐은 비닐류, 종이는 종이류로 나눌 수 있어요.

en.name: Cigarette pack
steps: Put it in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: If you remove the plastic and foil, you can sort the plastic with plastic film and the paper with paper.

zh.name: 烟盒
zh.warn: 拆下塑料膜和锡箔后，塑料膜可放塑料袋类回收，纸可放纸类回收。

ko.name: 쌀 포대
steps: 집에서 나온 쌀 포대는 종량제봉투에 넣어요
ko.warn: 종이 쌀 포대는 종이류로 받는 지역도 있어요.

en.name: Rice sack
steps: Rice sacks from home go in the pay-as-you-throw bag
en.warn: Some areas accept paper rice sacks as paper.

zh.name: 米袋
steps: 家里用的米袋放进计量垃圾袋
zh.warn: 有些地区纸米袋可以放纸类回收。

en.name: Potting soil
steps: Put it in the special sack for non-burnable waste (불연성 마대) and put it out

zh.name: 花盆土
steps: 装进不可燃垃圾专用麻袋（불연성 마대）放出去

ko.name: 와인병
ko.warn: 병 색깔은 상관없어요.

en.name: Wine bottle
steps: Put it in the glass bottle bin
en.warn: The bottle color doesn't matter.

zh.name: 红酒瓶
zh.warn: 瓶子颜色没关系。

ko.name: 세탁소 옷걸이
ko.warn: 세탁소에 돌려주면 받는 곳도 있어요.

en.name: Dry cleaner hangers
steps: Put them in the scrap metal bin
en.warn: Some dry cleaners take them back.

zh.name: 洗衣店衣架
zh.warn: 有些洗衣店会回收。

en.name: Dehumidifier box
steps: Pour the water inside down the drain
Put the foil lid in the pay-as-you-throw bag
Put the container in the plastics bin

zh.name: 除湿盒
steps: 把里面的水倒进下水道
铝箔盖放进计量垃圾袋

ko.name: 경찰
ko.desc: 범죄, 도난, 위협, 실종. 영어·중국어 통역이 24시간 연결돼요.

en.name: Police
en.desc: Crime, theft, threats, missing people. English and Chinese interpreters join the call 24/7.

zh.name: 警察
zh.desc: 犯罪、被盗、受到威胁、有人失踪。24小时提供英语、汉语翻译。

ko.name: 소방·구급
ko.desc: 화재, 다치거나 아플 때, 구조. 말이 어려우면 영상·문자로도 신고할 수 있어요.

en.name: Fire & ambulance
en.desc: Fire, injury or illness, rescue. If talking is hard, you can also report by video or text.

zh.name: 消防·急救
zh.desc: 火灾、受伤或生病、救援。说话困难时也可以用视频或短信报警。

ko.name: 관광통역안내
ko.desc: 24시간 한·영·일·중. 러·베·태·말레이어는 08~19시. 119와 1345에 연결해 줄 수 있어요. 해외 번호: +82-2-1330

en.name: Korea Travel Helpline
en.desc: 24/7 in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese. Russian, Vietnamese, Thai, Malay 08:00–19:00. Can connect you to 119 and 1345. From a foreign phone: +82-2-1330

zh.name: 旅游翻译咨询
zh.desc: 24小时提供韩、英、日、中文。俄、越、泰、马来语为08:00–19:00。可以帮你转接119和1345。外国号码请拨 +82-2-1330

ko.name: 외국인종합안내센터
ko.desc: 체류·생활 상담, 20개 언어. 평일 09~22시, 18시 이후는 한·영·중만.

en.name: Immigration Contact Center
en.desc: Visa and daily-life help in 20 languages. Weekdays 09:00–22:00; after 18:00 only Korean, English, Chinese.

zh.name: 外国人综合咨询中心
zh.desc: 居留和生活咨询，20种语言。工作日09:00–22:00，18点以后只有韩、英、中文。

t.en: I'm a foreigner. Please get an interpreter.
t.zh: 我是外国人，请帮我找翻译。

situations.ko: 제가 많이 아파요. 지금 갈 수 있는 병원이나 약국을 알려주세요.
situations.rom: Jega mani apayo. Jigeum gal su inneun byeongwoni-na yakgugeul allyeo juseyo.

t.zh: 我身体不舒服（找医院/药店）

situations.rom: Gyotong sagoga nasseoyo. Dachin sarami isseoyo.
